makehuman_hm08.base: hm08 (MPFB2 base.obj vertex order, 19158 verts; instance is a pure delta vs the macro-neutral base)

qa.folds_detail: 0 flipped faces at +1 over 1092 belly faces on BOTH the raw base.obj geometry (min_dot 0.055) and the MPFB default-macro evaluated base (min_dot 0.089); independently confirmed in Blender from the evaluated mesh (0 flips, min_dot 0.087). First folds appear at +1.05 on the raw base.
qa.landmark_caveat: Torso length is operationally defined (crotch = lowest near-midline vertex; neck base = first sustained gated torso width < 0.55 x chest width). Landmark placement tolerance is ~2-3 cm on ~0.65-0.75 m torsos, so s carries ~+-0.07 uncertainty; the anchor was nevertheless met to <1 mm after pinning.
qa.load_test: Loads via stock MPFB2 TargetService.load_target with no code changes; weight-0 evaluated state is bit-identical to the pre-load human. Note: Blender shape keys load with slider range [0, 1]; exercising negative weights requires extending the key's slider_min (a property tweak, done in the test harness only).
qa.negative_side: At -1 the reversed field folds (~140 of 1092 belly faces, both bases; Blender check 140). The source morph is one-sided; per MakeHuman convention a production negative pole should be a separately authored decrease target, not this file reversed.
qa.residual_note: Forward residual is the POC-analogous metric (result verts to source surface, torso-param space, mask core w>0.5). Bulk fidelity is near-exact (p50 0.039 cm); the p95 tail concentrates in (a) the navel pin patch (~29 verts, mandated by the anchor criterion - the two bases' neutral belly radii differ by ~1.9 cm at the navel, so displacement fidelity and surface conformance conflict by construction), (b) flank verts (the fit POC's named dead zone), (c) under-belly crease repair spots. The unpinned registration alone measured p95 0.130 cm but failed the anchor and folded at creases.

label: Belly

provenance.licence: study-only (internal) - NOT a CC0 MakeHuman asset; do not ship or redistribute
provenance.method: exact delta / foreign-fit transfer: non-rigid registration in torso-param space (arc/L, h, r/L) onto the source fat surface, kernel-field init; tight navel pin to the canonical displacement anchor; targeted dual-base fold repair
provenance.source: Fat Males body morph (learned, exact-topology delta vs Skyrim male base)

range.endpoint_anchor: max forward displacement at navel = 0.156 m on the source base (Fat Males); scaled by torso-length ratio s = 0.8325 to 0.1197 m on hm08

region.mask_rule: geodesic falloff from navel landmark, r = 0.35 x torso_len; full weight inside 0.65r, cosine falloff to 0 at r

semantics: Forward protrusion of the abdominal wall centred on the navel, with the under-belly roll and waist-crease shaping of the studied source morph. At +1 the abdominal surface at the navel landmark sits the full endpoint displacement forward of neutral; at 0 the base is untouched. One-sided source morph: the negative pole is the same field reversed and is NOT fold-safe at -1 (see qa.negative_side).
